ultima.settings.title: Ultima Settings
ultima.settings.persist_hint: Saved to ultima.properties. Mixins apply after a game restart.
ultima.settings.pending_restart: Restart the game to apply pending module changes.
ultima.settings.pending_line: Pending: restart the game to apply this change.
ultima.apply.rejoin_world: Changes to this option require rejoining the world.
ultima.apply.restart_game: Changes to this option require restarting the game.
ultima.module.retained_terrain.name: Retained terrain renderer
ultima.module.retained_terrain.tooltip: Keeps opaque terrain meshes on the GPU and submits them with multi-draw. Vanilla remains the fallback if the path cannot run. GPU command buffers are allocated for the world; toggling this after launch requires restarting the game.
ultima.module.java_mesher.name: Faster section mesher
ultima.module.java_mesher.tooltip: Uses a packed section compile loop with worker-owned scratch and tessellator reuse. Visit order matches vanilla BlockPos.betweenClosed.
ultima.module.mesher_fast_path.name: Hybrid mesher fast path
ultima.module.mesher_fast_path.tooltip: Experimental unit-cube fast path for proven vanilla cube models, including weighted unit cubes. Anything outside the proven coverage falls back to vanilla. Default off.
ultima.module.render_snapshot.name: Shared render snapshots
ultima.module.render_snapshot.tooltip: Shares immutable block-entity snapshots across SectionCopy objects of the same chunk during one extract. Does not share palettes.
ultima.module.section_task_queue.name: Section compile task queue
ultima.module.section_task_queue.tooltip: Compacts cancelled section compile tasks in one pass and parks workers on upload backpressure instead of spinning. Preserves vanilla nearest-task policy.
ultima.module.fsr_upscaling.name: FSR upscaling
ultima.module.fsr_upscaling.tooltip: Optional FSR1 spatial upscaling (EASU + RCAS). Renders the world at an internal resolution and upscales to native before HUD, GUI, and chat. Default off. Sodium-only is allowed. Iris (with or without Sodium) stays off: no safe post-Iris hook and Iris internal resolution is not controllable, so Ultima will not ship a native-res sharpen as if it were upscaling. Auto-off when Canvas is loaded. A quality preset appears under this toggle when it is on; RCAS sharpness remains 0.2.
ultima.module.entity_section_lookup.name: Faster entity lookups
ultima.module.entity_section_lookup.tool: Looks up entity sections that intersect a box instead of scanning every loaded section in the same chunk column.
ultima.module.block_collision_shape.name: Deferred collision shapes
ultima.module.block_collision_shape.tool: Only builds the collider voxel shape when a non-cube block actually needs to be intersected with it.
ultima.module.collision_shell_skip.name: Collision shell skip
ultima.module.collision_shell_skip.toolt: Rejects the one-block shell around a collision query without reading block states when no covered section can hold a shape that leaves its own cube. Requires Optimized block iteration.
ultima.module.supporting_block_shape_ski: Skips VoxelShape.move for full-cube blocks when finding the supporting block, which discards the shape and only keeps the BlockPos.
ultima.module.full_cube_move.name: Full-cube collision move
ultima.module.full_cube_move.tooltip: Replaces integer-offset full-cube VoxelShape.move with a compact world-space cube that matches vanilla collision.
ultima.module.cursor_step.name: Optimized block iteration
ultima.module.cursor_step.tooltip: Steps the block iteration cursor by carrying an increment instead of dividing a running index at every position. Required by Collision shell skip. Auto-disabled when Lithium, Canary, or Radium is loaded, because those mods replace the hot collision iterators.
ultima.module.blockentity_sleeping.name: Event-driven hopper sleeping
ultima.module.blockentity_sleeping.toolt: Skips proven-idle hopper work only while every audited vanilla mutation has a synchronous wake channel. Default off and auto-disabled with Lithium-family hopper optimizations.
ultima.module.recipe_match_cache.name: Recipe match cache
ultima.module.recipe_match_cache.tooltip: Caches vanilla first-match recipe, furnace, and brewing lookups while preserving ordered-match semantics. Invalidates on recipe reload and drops lookups after tag publication. Default off; Lithium remains allowed. Not a measured speedup.
ultima.module.tag_bitsets.name: Tag membership bitsets
ultima.module.tag_bitsets.tooltip: Answers audited tag membership from compact raw-id bitsets after tag bind/reload, with vanilla fallback for unknown tags or ids. Default off.
ultima.module.state_property_cache.name: Block-state property cache
ultima.module.state_property_cache.toolt: Memoizes proven-pure vanilla BlockState and FluidState properties while modded implementations fall back to vanilla. Default off.
ultima.module.container_slot_mask.name: Container slot mask
ultima.module.container_slot_mask.toolti: Maintains a conservative non-empty-slot mask for audited vanilla containers and verifies the hint against contents before using it. Unlisted or modded inventories fall back to vanilla.
ultima.module.entity_query_early_out.too: Returns early only for proven-empty entity-section queries and never filters a non-empty result. Default off and auto-disabled with Lithium-family entity-query optimizations.
ultima.module.iris_shader_frontend_artif: Persistent, checksummed cache of deterministic Iris CPU shader-transform output. The normal Iris driver compilation and link path remains unchanged. Requires the exact supported Iris build.
ultima.module.cross_pipeline_admission_b: Observes frame, Sodium queue, upload, server, and GC pressure. It does not defer Sodium work. Control and static requests stay unavailable until a safe budget boundary exists.
ultima.module.render_warmup_system.name: Render warmup system
ultima.module.render_warmup_system.toolt: Profiler only. No safe warmup adapter is active, so this does not remove first-use hitches.
ultima.module.rgss_endpoint.name: RGSS endpoint specialization
ultima.module.rgss_endpoint.tooltip: Experimental RGSS endpoint specialization. Keep off unless a measured RGSS-limited workload improves GPU frame time by at least 3%.
ultima.module.terrain_metrics.name: Terrain frame metrics
ultima.module.terrain_metrics.tooltip: Records terrain prepare/submit CPU, draw counts, and rebuild/upload counters. Does not change rendering.
ultima.module.client_benchmark.name: Client frame benchmark
ultima.module.client_benchmark.tooltip: Records reproducible client frame-time distributions when a benchmark is explicitly requested. Instrumentation only.
ultima.module.server_metrics.name: Server telemetry
ultima.module.server_metrics.tooltip: Records low-overhead server subsystem timings and counters and powers the opt-in /ultima profile trace. Instrumentation only; it does not change gameplay.
ultima.module.settings_ui.name: Title-screen settings button
ultima.module.settings_ui.tooltip: Adds an Ultima button on the title screen when Mod Menu is not installed. /ultima config and Mod Menu still work if this is off. Mixins apply at the next launch.
ultima.fsr.preset.tooltip: AMD FSR1 quality: Ultra Quality 1.3x, Quality 1.5x, Balanced 1.7x, Performance 2.0x, Ultra Performance 3.0x. Writes %1$s in ultima.properties. FSR Mixins still apply after a game restart. %2$s RCAS sharpness stays at the default %3$s stops; there is no sharpness slider in this menu yet.
ultima.status.enabled: Active: Mixins for this module were applied at launch.
ultima.status.no_safe_post_iris_integrat: Disabled: no safe post-Iris integration point. IrisApi has no official hook after its shader final pass; FSR stays off so Iris keeps working.
ultima.status.iris_internal_resolution_n: Disabled: Iris internal resolution is not controllable from Ultima, so upscaling would have no effect.
ultima.status.not_client_environment: Disabled: this module is client-only and is not available on a dedicated server.
ultima.status.disabled_by_default: Off: this module is opt-in and was not requested.
ultima.status.dependency_cycle: Disabled: this module is inactive because of a dependency cycle.
ultima.status.unknown_module: Disabled: unknown module names fail closed to vanilla.
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.none: Disabled: an incompatible mod is loaded.
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.sodium: Disabled: Sodium detected — this module conflicts with Sodium's renderer
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.iris: Disabled: Iris detected — this module conflicts with Iris shaders
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.canvas: Disabled: Canvas detected — this module conflicts with Canvas's renderer
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.lithium: Disabled: Lithium detected — this module conflicts with Lithium's collision and entity optimizations
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.canary: Disabled: Canary detected — this module conflicts with Canary's collision and entity optimizations
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.radium: Disabled: Radium detected — this module conflicts with Radium's collision and entity optimizations
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.other: Disabled: %1$s detected — this module conflicts with %1$s
ultima.status.incompatible_mod.multiple: Disabled: %1$s detected — this module conflicts with those mods
